caveat: Exploration tool, not a forecast: 6 buses, 4-hourly time steps, one weather year (2013), today's grid, fixed capacities (the model does not choose what to build). Costs are technology-data 2030 projections in EUR.

add_solar_GW.description: Solar PV added (+) or removed (-); additions by remaining technical potential

add_onwind_GW.description: Onshore wind added (+) or removed (-); additions by remaining potential

add_offwind_GW.description: Offshore wind added (+) or removed (-); additions by remaining potential (AC and DC sites)

add_battery_GW.description: Battery storage added (+, 4 h, by peak demand) or removed (-)

add_ccgt_GW.description: Gas CCGT added (+, by peak demand) or removed (-)

nuclear_restart.description: Existing nuclear plants restarted: chinshan, kuosheng, maanshan

add_nuclear_new_GW.description: New nuclear at the Lungmen site (the page sets it in plants of 1.35 GW, 0-5)

coal_retire_frac.description: Share of coal capacity retired (every coal plant scaled down)

co2_cap_frac.description: CO2 cap as a fraction of the base case's emissions; null = no cap

demand_scale.description: Annual demand relative to the base case (hourly shape unchanged)

line_rating.description: Usable share of each line's rating (0.7 = N-1 margin in the base)

currency.basis: Bank of Taiwan spot rate, buy/sell midpoint
